# Failure-to-Learn Review: Synthetic pump fire, 2024

**DRAFT**

Review: draft · Classification: internal · Version 1.0

Draft because: no finding is marked as edited by a person

*Learning purposes: not a statutory document · Learnings drafted by an AI agent from AI-assisted findings*

*About 2 min read*

**Audience:** Site leadership, top management and the board

**Incident:** Synthetic pump fire · 2024-03-20

## Bottom line

- The local seal purchases were on record for two years, but no step of the learning cycle turned them into a change. [FND-0003; EVD-0003]
- The return-to-service gap was known to supervision and was never planned out. [FND-0002] *(learning: LR-01)*

## Where the learning cycle broke

| Phase | What the export shows | Cites |
|---|---|---|
| Reporting | The local purchases were recorded, but nothing flagged them as a risk to report. | FND-0003; EVD-0003 |
| Investigation and analysis | No review asked why seals were bought without a specification. | FND-0003 |
| Planning interventions | No change was planned for the missing return-to-service checklist. | FND-0002; EVD-0002 |
| Intervening | Not in this export: no change was made, so none could be carried out. |  |
| Evaluating | Not in this export: no check of a change is recorded. |  |

## Missed opportunities

- 2022-03 (24 months before): Seals bought locally without a specification *(weak signal)* [FND-0003; EVD-0003]
  - Response: None recorded
  - Knowable then: The purchase record was visible to Stores at the time.
- 2024-03-12: Seal changed and the pump restarted with no return-to-service checklist [FND-0002]
  - Knowable then: yes

## How the practice drifted

Buying seals locally became the usual way to keep the pump running. Each purchase solved the day's problem, and no record asked whether the part matched the design. [FND-0003]

## Learnings for the organisation

**Learning:** A purchasing practice that bypasses the specification is a signal the organisation needs a route to hear. [FND-0003; EVD-0003]

Purchase records showed local seals for two years [FND-0003; EVD-0003]. No function owned the question of whether the parts were fit, so the signal never reached a review.

- Owner: Plant & Asset Leadership (F13, T4)

**Learning:** A known gap in supervision needs a planned change, not only a record. [FND-0002; FND-0003]

The missing return-to-service checklist was recorded in the procedure index [FND-0002; EVD-0002], and the spares programme that fed it was never resourced [FND-0003].

- Owner: Plant & Asset Leadership (F13, T4)

*(learning: LR-01)*

## A note on hindsight

This review knows the outcome; the people at the time did not. Each event shows what the records held then, and the learnings ask why the system did not act on it, not who missed it. [FND-0003]
